prayers.what_just_happened: The servant made his camels kneel near the well outside Nahor's town at evening, when the women came out to draw water.
prayers.key_line: O LORD, God of my master Abraham,” he prayed, “please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

prayers.what_just_happened: Manoah's wife told him that a man of God had appeared to her and promised that she would have a son who would be a Nazirite.
prayers.key_line: Please, O Lord, let the man of God You sent us come to us again to teach us how to raise the boy who is to be born.

prayers.what_just_happened: Hannah dedicated her son Samuel to the LORD, saying she had prayed for him and the LORD had granted her request.
prayers.key_line: My heart rejoices in the LORD; my horn is exalted in the LORD.

prayers.what_just_happened: Elisha's servant saw an enemy army surrounding the city and asked in fear what they should do, and Elisha told him not to be afraid.
prayers.key_line: O LORD, please open his eyes that he may see.

prayers.what_just_happened: The Aramean army came down against Elisha.
prayers.key_line: Please strike these people with blindness.

prayers.what_just_happened: Hezekiah received a threatening letter from Sennacherib's messengers, read it, and spread it out before the LORD in the temple.
prayers.key_line: You alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth.

prayers.what_just_happened: Ezra had been confessing that Israel broke God's commands by intermarrying with the surrounding peoples.
prayers.key_line: O LORD, God of Israel, You are righteous!

prayers.what_just_happened: Daniel understood from the sacred books that Jerusalem's desolation would last seventy years, so he turned to God with prayer, fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
prayers.key_line: For we are not presenting our petitions before You because of our righteous acts, but because of Your great compassion.

prayers.what_just_happened: In the garden of Gethsemane, Jesus went a little farther from His disciples and fell facedown to pray.
prayers.key_line: Yet not as I will, but as You will.

prayers.what_just_happened: Two men, a Pharisee and a tax collector, went up to the temple to pray, and the Pharisee stood by himself.
prayers.key_line: God, I thank You that I am not like other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.

prayers.who: The believers gathered in Jerusalem (the apostles and disciples)
prayers.what_just_happened: They proposed two men, Joseph called Barsabbas and Matthias, to replace Judas as a witness of Jesus' resurrection.

prayers.who: The believers, the early followers of Jesus
prayers.what_just_happened: Peter and John, freed after being threatened by the rulers, told the other believers, and they all prayed together.
prayers.key_line: And now, Lord, consider their threats, and enable Your servants to speak Your word with complete boldness,

terra.problem: Hannah is the speaker and the context is correct, but this poetic prayer of praise is also known as Hannah’s song. Exclude it under the no-songs rule.

The detail that the disciples’ eyes were heavy belongs to Jesus finding them asleep again after His second prayer (verse 43), not to what happened just before verse 42. Before the second prayer, He found them asleep and told them to watch and pray.
The authorities had specifically threatened Peter and John. They then reported to the other believers, who prayed together; verses 29–30 are part of that prayer.
